notes.title: Hello, Wholesome Games Celebration!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, and welcome to the 2025 Wholesome Games Celebration! My name is Graham and I'm the developer behind Ourlands--a cozy island builder where you handcraft bespoke little lands for quirky little characters. I'm very pleased to be able to show you new screenshots of the game today, featuring not only some UI, but a first look at one of the characters, Captain Beard Beard![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207723/c510a4c987990298428038ae1442c8d00e21b462.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207723/b3229ac8e677d54a7c84d24d62343855b26c722e.png"][/img][/p][p]The pirate captain is one of the many characters that will befriend you in Ourlands, requesting your help to create their perfect land. I can't wait to share more with you, including [b]the first ever demo[/b] for the game later this year (fingers crossed).[/p][p][/p][p]Please wishlist Ourlands if you haven't already. You don't want to miss out on future updates, demos, and the launch itself![/p][p][/p][p][i]Cheers,[/i][/p][p][i]-Graham[/i][/p]

notes.title: What is worldbuilding?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207723/317b3fe2dcffd322b0eb73e353f3315f23cb23cb.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

I've been working away at building the world for Ourlands. Traditionally, "worldbuilding' refers to developing a world with lore, history, locations, etc. In Ourlands, I'm using worldbuilding to mean creating all the things that will exist in the game. It does feel like I'm building a world from scratch after all.

I spent the past week illustrating a ton of new things and made this lil island to showcase them, but I'd love for you to chime in and lemme know what you would want to see on the little lands you build. Open to hearing all suggestions!

Likkle more,
Graham

notes.title: 🌴 Introducing, Ourlands 🌴
notes.notes:
Hey there! Graham here, and I'm thrilled have you along for this exciting journey. If this it the first time you're seeing this, I'm extremely proud to introduce you to my latest game! It's called [i]Ourlands[/i], and it is a cozy little game where you craft bespoke little lands for friendly little Islanders. 

In case you missed it - the official announce trailer was just revealed as a part of the Six One Indie Showcase. Check it out 👇🏽

[previewyoutube=H5EmFXgvE_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you're liking what you've seen so far (and hearing too - shout out to Fat Bard for lending their musical talents to the trailer)! There's plenty more to come, so stay tuned. Make sure you wishlist the game and follow my developer page so that you get all the updates when I post them here - there [i]will[/i] be updates coming in hot right here on Steam.

I'm really looking forward to sharing more and more with you, and even moreso looking forward to seeing what you end up sharing as you eventually get your hands on the game.

Likkle more,
Graham
🌴
